descriptors.name: cdm.party.LegalEntity
descriptors.label: Legal Entity
descriptors.description: A legal entity — a named institution with an optional set of identifiers such as the LEI. Realises cdm.base.staticdata.party.LegalEntity; the firm's register of the counterparties it faces and its own booking entities.

name.name: name
name.label: Name
name.description: The legal entity's legal name, e.g. "BlackRock Investment Management (UK) Limited".

entityIdentifier.name: entityIdentifier
entityIdentifier.label: Entity Identifiers
entityIdentifier.description: The entity's identifiers — LEI, BIC, RED pair id, MIC, country code — in CDM's own shape.
